Customer_Message: I have been waiting 22 days for my refund. The return was delivered to Amazon but nothing has happened. I am a Prime member and this is unacceptable.
Agent_Notes: Escalated to refund team. Refund processed manually. Customer informed.

Customer_Message: The return QR code I was given has been rejected at 4 different drop-off locations. I cannot return this item and the window is closing.
Agent_Notes: QR code was corrupted in system. New label issued. Customer confirmed successful drop-off.

Customer_Message: I returned my laptop 3 weeks ago and received a refund that is $200 less than what I paid. No explanation was provided.
Agent_Notes: Partial refund was a system error. Remaining balance refunded. Customer satisfied.

Customer_Message: A third-party seller is refusing my return even though the product is defective. I have been waiting 25 days with no resolution.
Agent_Notes: Amazon intervened. A-to-z Guarantee claim filed. Full refund issued to customer.

Customer_Message: I am trying to return a jacket but the return option is completely greyed out in my account. I cannot figure out why.
Agent_Notes: Item was flagged incorrectly as non-returnable. Flag removed. Customer completed return online.

Customer_Message: My return was accepted and I dropped it off 18 days ago. I have not received my refund and support keeps telling me it is being processed.
Agent_Notes: Item was stuck in the returns warehouse scan queue. Manually cleared. Refund issued.

Customer_Message: I returned two items in the same parcel but only received a refund for one. The second item refund has not appeared after 2 weeks.
Agent_Notes: Second item barcode was not scanned at warehouse. Refund issued manually after investigation.

Customer_Message: The seller on a third-party listing is claiming I damaged the product during the return. I packaged it perfectly. They are refusing the refund.
Agent_Notes: Photos reviewed. Seller claim rejected. Full refund processed under buyer protection policy.

Customer_Message: I need to return an oversized item but the return system only offers drop-off options which do not work for a large appliance.
Agent_Notes: Scheduled courier pickup arranged for oversized item. Customer confirmed pickup date.

Customer_Message: Just wanted to say the agent who helped me yesterday was absolutely brilliant. My refund issue was sorted in minutes. Thank you.
Agent_Notes: Positive feedback logged. Agent recognised.

Customer_Message: I received a partial refund after returning my phone. The amount is $150 short and I have no idea why. No email explanation was sent.
Agent_Notes: Refund breakdown sent to customer. System calculation error identified and corrected. Full amount refunded.

Customer_Message: The return drop-off location near my house no longer accepts Amazon returns but the app still shows it as active. Wasted a trip.
Agent_Notes: Location data updated in system. Customer directed to nearest active drop-off point.

Customer_Message: A third-party seller told me my 30-day return window expired. The item only arrived 5 days ago due to a shipping delay. This is not fair.
Agent_Notes: Return window extended to account for shipping delay. Seller notified of policy. Return approved.

Customer_Message: I have escalated my refund 3 times. Every time I contact support they say it is being processed but nothing happens. I want to speak to a manager.
Agent_Notes: Senior agent assigned. Root cause was a payment processing hold. Refund released. Manager called customer directly.

Customer_Message: The return instructions for my large coffee machine were very confusing. I almost sent it without proper packaging and could have voided my return.
Agent_Notes: Improved return instructions sent to customer. Feedback escalated to UX team for packaging guidance review.

Customer_Message: My refund arrived but it was $5 short. I think it might be a rounding error.
Agent_Notes: Pricing rounding error confirmed. $5 credit applied to account. Customer thanked.

Customer_Message: I returned a $900 laptop to a third-party seller 4 weeks ago. The seller has gone silent. I have lost nearly $1000 and no one is helping me.
Agent_Notes: A-to-z Guarantee claim escalated urgently. Seller account under review. Full refund issued immediately.

Customer_Message: The return label I printed at home would not scan at the drop-off point. The staff there could not help and I had to drive to a UPS store.
Agent_Notes: Label format incompatibility identified. Digital QR code issued. Customer completed return successfully.

Customer_Message: I returned a dress a week ago and the refund has not come back to my original payment method. It shows as store credit instead.
Agent_Notes: Refund method set incorrectly in system. Corrected to original payment method. Customer confirmed receipt.

Customer_Message: I ordered a refurbished phone and it arrived in worse condition than described. The seller is refusing the return saying it meets the condition guidelines.
Agent_Notes: Condition guidelines reviewed. Seller claim rejected. Replacement dispatched. Return collected.

Customer_Message: I have been trying to return a blender for 10 days but the return option keeps showing a system error when I try to submit.
Agent_Notes: Backend return portal error identified. Engineering ticket raised. Manual return processed for customer.

Customer_Message: Everything went perfectly with my return. The QR code worked first time and my refund arrived the next day. Brilliant.
Agent_Notes: Positive feedback logged.

Customer_Message: A third-party seller has rejected 2 return requests for a defective tablet. I paid $650 and have no working product and no refund.
Agent_Notes: A-to-z Guarantee filed. Seller suspended pending review. Immediate full refund issued to customer.

Customer_Message: Just checking when my return refund will arrive. I returned the item 5 days ago.
Agent_Notes: Refund on track. Expected within 2 business days. Customer updated.

Customer_Message: I dropped off my return 3 weeks ago and the tracking still shows it as in transit. My refund window will close before it is marked as received.
Agent_Notes: Return traced. Lost in transit at carrier. Immediate refund issued without requiring return receipt.
